create_wrapped_dataset_with_enumerated_t: create a DatasetWithEnumeratedTargets wrapping an existing PyTorch Dataset to add index-based enumerated targets
create_padded_dataset_for_distributed_tr: create a DatasetWithEnumeratedTargets with pad_dataset=True and num_replicas set for distributed training
get_image_relative_path: get the relative file path of an image at a given index from the wrapped dataset
get_image_raw_bytes: get the raw image bytes at a given index from the wrapped dataset
get_enumerated_target: get the enumerated target tuple containing the sample index and original target for a given index
